name: Chizpita
spelling: CHIZPITA in logos, Chizpita in running text: one word, always with a C.
trademark: Use ™ (never ®). Every lockup with the wordmark already carries a small ™ top-right; the mark, icons, favicons and mascot art do not. In text, write Chizpita™ on the first or most prominent mention of a page, post, flyer or package, then plain Chizpita.
mascot_name: Chizpita (the mascot carries the brand name)
flavor_notes: El Clásico is the plain cheese flavor; same name in every language.
rules: Pick the asset by use case below. Full-color artwork is PNG (illustration plus vector type); one-color artwork and the wordmark are SVG. Never recolor, redraw or retype; regenerate with `make`. Full rules: BRAND.md.

website_header_narrow.note: under 360px viewport width or when the header is under 160px wide

order_page_confirm_animation.note: pop in with a small scale overshoot; the spark on the i can twinkle

whatsapp_business_avatar.note: the mascot's face: reads at 40px in chat lists

avatar_badge_alt.note: full badge; text is too small below ~120px

flyer.note: the badge brings its own cream ground, so it works on chalkboard flyers

wordmark_only.note: when the pita or the mascot is already nearby

masters.full_color: PNG, 2x the layout grid: logo/badge, logo/horizontal, logo/stacked, logo/mark, logo/icon, mascot/
masters.vector: SVG: logo/wordmark (all variants) and every one-color version (mono-dark, mono-light)

variants.color: full color, for light grounds (paper, cream, white)
variants.color-reversed: full color with a cream wordmark, for dark grounds
variants.mono-dark: one color roast #2A1A0F: stamps, kraft, embroidery, gold grounds
variants.mono-light: one color cream #FFF3DC: dark grounds, dark fabric
